name: Datapower.mat
description: Code and simulated dataset accompanying the manuscript "Multimodal Fault Detection in Wind Turbines under Synthetic Operating-Condition and Sensor Perturbations: A Simulation-Based Evaluation". The archive contains: (1) Datapower.mat, a simulated wind energy conversion system dataset (seven operating modes, one healthy and six IGBT open-circuit, short-circuit and wear-out faults; 2000 training and 2000 test samples per mode; 12 monitored variables); (2) windfdd_v5.py, the Python implementation that produced all results in the paper, including all seeds, hyperparameters and fold/block definitions; (3) WindFDD_Multimodal_v5.m, an equivalent MATLAB implementation; (4) the full run log. Running python windfdd_v5.py Datapower.mat --set=nTrees:100,nTreesMeta:150 regenerates every table, figure and number in the Results section.
